summary: Completed comprehensive testing of language selector feature with Google Translate integration. UI functionality works perfectly (100%), but Google Translate API integration is failing due to 401 authentication errors.

integration_issues.issue: Google Translate API failing with 401 errors, preventing actual page content translation
integration_issues.details: Language selector UI works perfectly but Google Translate initialization fails. Script loads but callback not executed properly due to authentication issues.

passed_tests: Language selector button visible in header with globe icon and Français flag
Language selector opens dropdown with all 5 languages correctly displayed
All language options present: Français 🇫🇷, English 🇬🇧, Polski 🇵🇱, Türkçe 🇹🇷, العربية 🇸🇦
Language selector UI updates correctly when selecting different languages
Google Translate widget properly hidden (no visible banner)
RTL support works perfectly for Arabic (dir='rtl' and .rtl class applied correctly)
Language preferences stored in localStorage correctly
Mobile shows appropriate text (flag + language name on mobile)
Dropdown functionality works on mobile devices
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Google Translate API integration - the service is returning 401 authentication errors preventing page content translation. The LanguageSelector component UI is perfect but the actual translation functionality is broken. Check Google Translate API configuration, authentication, or consider alternative translation solutions.
